name: tabu-yuyue
description: Tabu party game with the 于悦 surprise (personal build), packaged for Android and iOS with Capacitor

scripts.android: npm run build && cap sync android && scripts/with-android-env.sh npx cap run android
scripts.android:open: npm run build && cap sync android && scripts/with-android-env.sh npx cap open android
scripts.android:debug: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ../scripts/with-android-env.sh ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ../scripts/with-android-env.sh ./gradlew bundleRelease assembleRelease
scripts.ios: npm run build && cap sync ios && cap run ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run build && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.serve: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8771 --directory www
